# linuxptp and chrony clock-log fixtures

Written for Kshana from the public documentation of the line layouts (the linuxptp `ptp4l`,
`phc2sys` and `ts2phc` servo lines, and the chrony `log tracking` and `log statistics`
columns). The values are made up. No log from a real installation, and no text copied from
linuxptp or chrony, is in this directory, so no third-party licence applies; the files are
AGPL-3.0-only with the rest of the repository. They check that the parsers read the
layout the documentation describes, not that they read every log a real daemon writes.
